description: This source file defines the BookRepository interface in a Spring Data JPA context, providing database access methods for the Book entity, including various specialized queries with entity graphs for optimized fetching.

classes.name: BookRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Book entity, providing CRUD operations and custom queries with entity graph annotations.

methods.name: findAllBooks
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all books with their authors, predefined shelves, tags, and publishers fetched eagerly.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all books with specified associations eagerly loaded.

methods.name: findBookById
methods.description: Finds a specific book by ID with associated entities loaded.

methods.name: findByTitleContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds books whose titles contain the specified substring, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Searches for books where the title or author's full name matches the given input, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findAllBooksByPredefinedShelfShelfName
methods.description: Retrieves books belonging to a predefined shelf identified by its name.

methods.name: findAllBooksForUser
methods.description: Retrieves books associated with a specific user, considering books on user-created shelves.
